question: Where in the prompt does the same-position (diagonal) term change the outcome? For each prompt position p, compare the full and off-diagonal lenses at matched edit norm on the relational margin, leakage margin and generated outcome.
prior_evidence: Region-level only: C32 (prefix / question / whole prompt, raw columns) and C37/C38 (prefix / whole prompt, unit columns). Whole prompt: lambda 0->2 raises dR by +3 to +5 and dL by about +5 nats; prefix only: lambda does almost nothing. No per-token resolution exists.
panel: data/heldout/concept-use.json, frozen eligibility results/concept/eligibility.json; clues 0 and 1, filler 0, use queries only (1,339 trials, 661 units)

intervention.construction: C38's whole-prompt swap built once on the clean residual, unit columns, every arm row-matched to the full lens's delta norm at every (layer, position); then masked by position

modes.all: no mask; must reproduce C38 c38magprompt

intervention.generation: 8 greedy tokens from the edited prompt; nothing re-injected

outcomes.dR: change from clean in log p(target answer) - log p(source answer), teacher-forced
outcomes.dL: change from clean in log p(target name) - log p(target answer), teacher-forced
outcomes.success: continuation begins with a target-answer alias
outcomes.leak: target name in the continuation and not success

roles.template: tokens of 'Fact: Consider' (position 0, the attention sink, reported separately)

estimands.primary: Delta_D(p) = Y(lam1_cn) - Y(lam0_cn) under the single mode, per trial, averaged within role; also by distance from the readout
secondary: within-trial slope of Y on lambda over {0, 0.5, 1, 2}, per role

predictions.P1: single-site Delta_D on dL is positive at the readout and larger there than at any prefix role
predictions.P2: at prefix roles, single-site Delta_D on success is >= -2 pp (the diagonal is not harmful upstream)
predictions.P3: dropping the readout removes a larger share of the whole-prompt Delta_D on dL than dropping any other single position

inference: 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals over source entities, 2000 resamples, seed 0; trials weighted equally, unit-weighted as sensitivity; replicated across the two lenses
gates: record count equals the 1,339 eligible use trials, summed over shards
every shard's source_sha equals the local module's
all-mode log-probs reproduce c38magprompt for the four shared arms (median |diff| < 0.02 nats)
applied-norm spread across arms < 1e-3 at every live site
